title: 13 Best Employee Engagement Survey Tools in 2026 (Tested & Compared)
summary: Compare the 13 best employee engagement survey tools in 2026, with key features, use cases, and what to consider when choosing the right platform.
body_markdown:
After evaluating 30+ employee engagement survey tools and hands-on testing features like multilingual support and[AI-powered analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/how-ai-powered-hr-metrics-drive-better-people-decisions-in-2025) , I've identified the platforms that deliver on measuring engagement and motivation. Engagement measurements affect productivity, retention, and corporate culture. The tools I've tested range from $4 per user per month to $30 per user per month. Finding the right employee satisfaction survey platform for your budget matters. In this piece, I'll walk you through the best employee engagement survey and employee feedback survey solutions, with decision-critical details that help you choose the tool fitting your culture and goals.


## [inFeedo AI](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


Image Source:[inFeedo AI](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


InFeedo AI's Amber operates as an AI-powered Chief Engagement Officer built on 9 years of People Science research and 80 million employee responses. The platform serves 330+ enterprise CHROs in 60+ countries. It distinguishes itself through its proprietary PTM (People-To-Meet) algorithm that identifies disengaged employees 60 to 90 days before they resign.


### Best For


Mid-market and enterprise organizations that manage distributed teams where[regretted attrition](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-engagement/regretted-vs-unregretted-attrition-rate) costs more than ticket volume. The platform excels in companies with thin HRBP ratios where system-driven coverage matters more than headcount expansion.


### Key Features


The PTM algorithm analyzes sentiment patterns, behavioral shifts and silence indicators to rank employees by attrition risk. Silent employees present a critical challenge. They're 3x more likely to quit than survey respondents. Amber spots these individuals through passive signals from existing HR data rather than waiting for feedback that never arrives.


Conversational AI triggers natural-language check-ins at career-defining moments: first month onboarding, project changes, manager transitions, post-promotion periods and pre-exit phases. The platform tracks employee trajectory by connecting responses over time and catches gradual decline that point-in-time surveys miss.


InFeedo.ai has three modules: Listening (continuous feedback and[predictive insights](https://www.infeedo.ai/predictive-people-analytics) ), Automation (service delivery and workflow automation), and Communication (targeted campaigns and individual-specific messaging). The Automation module resolves about 70% of employee queries with 95% answer accuracy. Organizations achieve 90% response rates due to empathetic interactions, much higher than traditional engagement tools.


Report Studio delivers decision-ready analytics with AI summaries and 50+ filters scheduled to leadership inboxes. The system identifies localized problems that combined scores mask, such as a 12-person team at 35% engagement inside a company-wide score of 80%.


### Pros and Cons


**Pros:**


- Employees who engage with Amber are 2x more likely to stay at organizations
- 84% response rate for 130,000 employees at Genpact
- Automates 98% of routine HR queries
- Multilingual support in 30+ languages


**Cons:**


- Pricing requires contacting sales team
- No free tier available


### Pricing


InFeedo quotes pricing per employee based on headcount and selected modules. Contact sales for detailed pricing through their official website.


### Why Choose inFeedo AI


Genpact deployed Amber for 130,000 employees with measurable results: the platform became the only non-financial metric driving bonus pools for 200+ leaders. Crompton retained 88% of attrition-risk employees identified by the PTM algorithm. The 60 to 90-day prediction window provides time for career conversations, scope adjustments or compensation corrections before departure becomes inevitable.


## [Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/platform/engage)


Image Source:[Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Culture Amp positions itself as CultureOS, an intelligence layer that connects culture and performance through People Science increased by AI. The platform now combines smoothly inside Claude and ChatGPT. This reflects its focus on embedding engagement capabilities within existing workflows rather than requiring separate check-ins.


### Best For


Mid-to-large companies with dedicated HR or People Ops teams that prefer survey-driven engagement measure over conversational AI approaches. The platform serves organizations that seek research-backed survey templates rather than free-form feedback collection.


### Key Features


Culture Amp structures around three core modules. **Engage** provides 40+ survey templates that cover onboarding, pulse checks, exit interviews and diversity initiatives. AI comment analysis processes open-ended feedback. Heatmaps show engagement patterns across demographics like geography and tenure. One reviewer noted that tenure analysis exposed lower engagement in the five-to-seven-year employee cohort. This enabled targeted actions.


**Perform** manages[performance reviews](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-performance-review-guide-for-managers) , 1-on-1 conversations and goal alignment. The system combines smoothly with Google Calendar to recognize scheduled one-to-ones. It prompts both participants to use a shared virtual board for agenda items and notes. Calibrations ensure HR decisions remain consistent across departments.


**Develop** handles career pathing and growth plans. Skills Coach delivers daily learning lessons through Slack, email and Microsoft Teams. The 2025 addition of AI Coach provides managers with personalized guidance drawn from the platform's dataset.


AI Coach surfaces key themes across survey questions. This helps managers identify focus areas faster than manual analysis. The tool cooperates with leaders to build action plans and draft communications for different audiences. Recognition capabilities combine smoothly with Slack, where shout-outs attach to company values and feed into employee profiles for review evidence.


Culture Amp draws from[1.6 billion survey responses](https://www.cultureamp.com/platform) to provide benchmarks and confirm question effectiveness. Security compliance has SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR certification. The platform combines smoothly with ADP, Workday, BambooHR and Microsoft Teams.


### Pros and Cons


**Pros:**


- 40% faster implementation for Enterprise Performance Management compared to alternatives
- Survey templates backed by organizational psychology research
- User-friendly interface with sophisticated analytics capabilities


**Cons:**


- Quote-based pricing with no public rates
- Limited reporting customization options
- Manual CSV upload required for large survey distribution
- Learning curve for first-time users


### Pricing


Culture Amp operates on annual-only contracts with sales-led quotes. Third-party procurement data indicates costs between[INR 421.90 to INR 759.42 per employee per month](https://www.compono.com/articles/culture-amp-pricing-guide-2026) . Small teams (15-75 employees) see annual spend around INR 379,712 to INR 759,424 for Engage-only packages. Mid-market organizations (200-500 employees) pay INR 1,687,609 to INR 4,640,925 annually when bundling Engage and Perform modules. Enterprise contracts for 1,000+ employees range from INR 3,375,218 to INR 6,750,436+ per year.


### Why Choose Culture Amp


Culture Amp fits organizations that prioritize survey methodology over up-to-the-minute conversational engagement. The People Science foundation appeals to HR leaders who need to justify engagement initiatives with research backing rather than relying on sentiment analysis alone. Implementation completes within two months. The platform requires dedicated HR resources to manage ongoing survey cadences and interpret results effectively though.


## Qualtrics


Image Source:[Qualtrics](https://www.qualtrics.com/)


Qualtrics operates on[custom quote-only pricing](https://www.qualtrics.com/articles/employee-experience/employee-engagement/) without published rates and positions itself for enterprise-scale organizations rather than mid-market teams. The platform requires consultation with sales teams to determine costs based on headcount and module selection. This creates a barrier for companies seeking transparent pricing evaluation.


### Best For


Large enterprises with research-trained analysts on staff who need advanced survey logic and cross-functional experience management beyond[employee engagement](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/employee-engagement) . The platform serves organizations already invested in the wider Qualtrics XM suite. Integration with customer experience and market research data justifies the deployment complexity.


### Key Features


The EX25 solution provides a guided employee engagement program using a pre-built framework that covers the all-encompassing employee experience. Organizations deploy[pulse surveys](https://www.infeedo.ai/pulse-surveys) using 290+ science-backed questions or custom queries tailored to company culture. AI-powered verbatim analysis identifies trending concerns across thousands of comments and reduces analysis time from weeks to minutes.


Manager dashboards deliver personalized action recommendations based on specific team feedback and best practices rooted in I/O science. Only 1% of managers act on team feedback without structured guidance consistently. So the platform has conversational AI that allows managers to ask deeper questions about their insights.


The system measures engagement, inclusion and wellbeing with over 300 survey items.[Retention Analytics](https://www.capterra.in/software/140443/qualtrics-employee-engagement) links engagement scores to attrition data and simulates flight-risk scenarios. Organizations compare their strategies against standard sets that track metrics like well-being, inclusion and intent to stay. The platform integrates with existing HR systems to capture continuous sentiment from various sources.


### Pros and Cons


**Pros:**


- Live dashboards with AI-powered analytics eliminate waiting for reports
- Benchmarking against Fortune 500 and industry datasets
- 500K employees providing regular feedback across deployments


**Cons:**


- No self-service setup; deployment involves consultants and weeks of configuration
- Admin console built for research analysts, not generalist HR staff
- Multi-year enterprise contracts without test-before-commit options


### Pricing


Qualtrics bases pricing on interactions (data records collected or processed) rather than simple per-user fees. Full deployment can require professional services for custom integration requests. Contact sales for quotes scaled to headcount and modules.


### Why Choose Qualtrics


Organizations with 15,000+ employees already using the Qualtrics XM Platform for customer experience gain efficiency by consolidating employee feedback within the same ecosystem. The State of Iowa's centralized program created applicable feedback loops through the platform. This demonstrates fit for government and large public sector entities that require unified experience management.

Mid-market and enterprise companies running structured[performance cycles](https://www.infeedo.ai/performance-management-guide) with dedicated HR teams. Lattice structures around modular products: Performance (reviews, feedback, 1:1s), Goals & OKRs (alignment and tracking), Engagement (pulse surveys, eNPS, exit interviews), and Compensation (benchmarking, cycle management). The AI Agent answers HR questions and coaches managers. It acts on workforce data rather than functioning as a simple chatbot.


Pulse surveys support multiple question types with automated scheduling and immediate analytics that include sentiment analysis and heatmaps. The platform blends top themes from survey data using open-ended feedback and engagement scores. Manager dashboards provide suggested actions grouped by themes to address specific concerns.


Lattice integrates with Slack for feedback, praise tied to company values, and survey responses without switching tools. The mobile app (iOS and Android) enables review submission, goal tracking, and 1:1 management from any location.

**Cons:**

## [15Five](https://www.15five.com/)


15Five centers on manager enablement through continuous feedback rhythms rather than periodic survey snapshots. The platform serves 250,000 employees at[over 3,000 organizations](https://www.15five.com/pricing) . Weekly check-ins form the operational foundation that feeds performance reviews, goal tracking and engagement measurement.


### Best For


Mid-market companies between 100 and 1,000 employees with mature manager layers and coaching-oriented cultures. The platform serves technology, professional services and healthcare organizations that prioritize[manager-employee dialog](https://www.infeedo.ai/performance-management/how-employee-evaluation-can-enhance-the-growth-and-performance-of-an-organization) over survey-only approaches.


### Key Features


Weekly check-ins capture what employees worked on, challenges they faced and support they needed. This creates steady context streams for managers. Continuous input builds performance reviews on actual data rather than memory. AI summarizes themes and reduces bias in review language.


The **Perform** module combines performance reviews, 1-on-1s, OKRs and career growth tools at INR 928.18 per user monthly. **Engage** delivers engagement surveys with AI-powered analytics at INR 337.52 per user monthly. Recognition through high fives links to company values and feeds employee profiles with review evidence.


The[HR Outcomes Dashboard](https://www.infeedo.ai/people-analytics/maximizing-hr-efficiency-with-an-hr-dashboard) combines performance, engagement and feedback trends organization-wide. One-on-one meeting tools help managers run focused conversations with documented agendas. Goal tracking connects daily work to broader OKRs so employees understand how they contribute to larger objectives.


### Pros and Cons


**Pros:**


- Easy-to-use interface with straightforward navigation
- Detailed progress tracking across teams
- Recognition system engages employees in large organizations


**Cons:**


- Annual billing only with no monthly option
- INR 1350.09 base platform cost compounds with manager add-ons reaching INR 4134.64 monthly
- Interface requires clicking through multiple screens

### Why Choose 15Five


[Kreg Tools reduced turnover from 40% to 32%](https://www.15five.com/) after implementation. Auror maintains 94% retention when managers use the platform to understand employees. The weekly check-in rhythm works when managers commit to regular engagement. Teams without formal enablement programs struggle with empty check-ins though.

The platform connects engagement signals to recognition actions without manual work. A sentiment dip triggers a ready-to-send recognition prompt rather than requiring manual interpretation.
